title: cert.rs: trust anchor loop tries only first valid-date anchor for signature
description: In validate_chain(), when multiple trust anchors share the same DN (CA renewal scenario), the code collects all DN-matching candidates and correctly filters by validity date. However it then calls verify_signature() on only the first valid-date candidate (using find()). If that anchor's public key doesn't match (same DN, different key — which is the exact scenario the comment acknowledges), the function returns an error without trying the remaining valid-date candidates. Fix: change the anchor selection to iterate all valid-date candidates and return Ok on the first successful signature verification, returning Err only if all fail.
